title: Alignment Member Relief on Replacement Tire Mounting — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
On the one-tire replacement ticket written for an adjusted Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty tire, member labor relief is taken off the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire according to the vehicle's plan under Alignment Services & Plans.

| Plan on the vehicle | Relief |
|---|---|
| active lifetime alignment plan (Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan, Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance) | 10% of the mount-and-balance charge per tire |
| active Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan or Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | 5% of it |
| any other vehicle | nothing |

Each relief on the mounting charge is worked out on its own, and the mounting charge less every relief taken off it is never below 0.

**Worked (hypothetical $25.00 charge):** lifetime plan — $2.50; 1-year plan — $1.25; plan cancelled — nothing.
